en: A monochrome historic postcard showing a multi‑storey building with a steep tiled roof and dormer windows. The façade is relatively plain except for a richly decorated bay window or oriel, framed by ornate Baroque-style carvings and columns. A wooden fence and climbing plants line the street in front of the building. In the upper right corner there is printed red text in German, and a red handwritten year-like note appears vertically along the right edge.
